## How do people in pre-industrial societies learn to make tools?

- Sub-questions: 1. Do hunter-gatherers have a unique learning pattern compared with other groups? 2. Do learning strategies change across different developmental periods? 3. What are some major transmission biases involved?

- Descriptive study: Global sample using eHRAF World Cultures (searching strategy: Subject "transmission of skills" + Keyword "tools")

- Variables: location, age, number and relationship of learner and model, learning processes, transmission bias, skill difficulty, technology, access to raw materials, etc.
